A dessert in six acts

Tiramisu,
built layer by layer.

Scroll to watch coffee, biscuits, cream and cocoa assemble into a dessert.

01
Coffee and rumThe first pour

01 / Coffee & rum

A dark, fragrant start.

Combine the espresso and rum, then let it cool. The ladyfingers will soak up this coffee mixture.

200 ml espresso2 tbsp rum

02 / Ladyfingers

Dip. Place. Repeat.

Dip each biscuit briefly into the cooled coffee, then lay them neatly in the dish.

2 packages ladyfingers

03 / Mascarpone cream

A cloud of cream.

Beat mascarpone, sweet cream and powdered sugar until smooth and softly whipped. Spread a generous layer over the biscuits.

500 g mascarpone300 ml sweet cream~3 tbsp powdered sugar

04 / Build it up

Another layer, please.

Add more coffee-dipped ladyfingers, then another blanket of cream. Repeat for as many layers as you like.

05 / Cocoa dust

The finishing touch.

A soft snowfall of cocoa powder gives the top its signature bittersweet finish.

Cocoa powder

06 / Ready to serve

Layered with love.

Take a moment to admire those layers. Chill before serving for the best texture.

Replay the build ↑

The shopping list

Everything you need.

  • 200 ml espresso
  • 2 tbsp rum
  • 2 packages ladyfingers
  • 500 g mascarpone
  • 300 ml sweet cream
  • Around 3 tbsp powdered sugar
  • Cocoa powder
